claims: Bone (teal): the injected upper tooth, drawn on the canine, with its root and the alveolar bone over it (record: anaesthesia to individual upper teeth by supraperiosteal infiltration).

Bone (amber, lighter): the lateral incisor and first premolar beside it. Not stated in the record: general dental teaching that infiltration through the porous maxilla often partly numbs adjacent teeth; kept lighter and labelled less reliable. Owner, 2026-10-15: one tooth alone looked wrong.
Right-sided block (patient's right ear and cheek face the viewer); one tone per nerve, key shown under the image in the app.
